title: Two-Thirds of Image Buyers Say Human-Made Beats AI-Generated
excerpt: Two-thirds of the professionals who buy stock images say human-made work is higher quality than AI-generated work, and half have turned AI-generated stock away in the past year. The market is drawing a line, and it favors photographers.

title: Your Ultra-Wide Landscapes Look Flat Because You Are Standing Too Far Back
excerpt: An ultra-wide lens does not flatten a landscape on its own. Standing too far from the foreground does. Get within a foot or two of the nearest rock and the depth comes back.

title: What Ten Years With One Subject Can Teach You
excerpt: Ivan McClellan first encountered Black rodeo culture in Oklahoma in 2015. A decade of returning built the relationships behind Eight Seconds: Legacy in Motion, a book of more than 90 previously unpublished photographs.
